A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.what: the accumulation is guarded by `row < rows && (cols % 64u) == 0u`. If cols is not a multiple of 64 the loop never runs, acc_g and acc_u stay 0, and the kernel WRITES silu(0)*0 = 0 for every row -- a full zero activation with no error and no fallback.
A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.reachable_here: NO. hidden_size 5120 and intermediate_size 17408 are both multiples of 64 on this body, so the branch never fires and no measurement here is affected.
A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.why_it_is_recorded: a shape that silently produces zeros is the class this program keeps finding, and the guard is one artifact away from firing. Not fixed because changing a production shader's guard direction needs its own evidence and its own control.
A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.also_a_naming_hazard: the UNFUSED MLP kernel is named qwen_affine_q2_group32_matvec_geo_tpr64_tg128 and branches on a RUNTIME group_size, taking the g64 path on this artifact. MIX_REPORT.json says so in its own words -- kernel_family 'affine2_group32_matvec (group_size bind 32 or 64)'. The atlas histogram names a kernel FAMILY, not the codec that executed, and a reader taking group32 literally would conclude the fused g64 kernel was reading the wrong scales.

claim_boundary: ONE artifact, ONE prompt (11 tokens), ONE generation length (64 new, EOS at 49), ONE machine, INSTANCE. The 3.75% at equal dispatch count is measured at this length and this shape and nothing here says it holds at 1024 tokens.
3 admitted sweeps per arm. The result is admitted by COMPLETE SEPARATION of clusters whose spreads are 0.12-0.37% -- far inside the 10% gate -- and not by a 200-rep count.

The two capability runs are NOT PAIRED and their timing is unusable, which the receipt states rather than quoting the 19% it produced. What they establish is the 30/43 FLOOR and the 43/43 semantic identity, neither of which drifts with machine load.

The 34.8x DRAM overshoot RULES OUT a bandwidth explanation for the pair lever; it does NOT establish which of load-issue, cache traffic or register pressure is the mechanism. The experiment that would settle it -- a kernel that fuses the dispatch while still loading the input twice -- does not exist and was not built.

GPU time is per-COMMAND-BUFFER (GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime), so every per-dispatch figure here is a MARGINAL derived by differencing two graphs, not a per-dispatch measurement. Metal timestamp counter sampling is probed as supported and deliberately not encoded (crates/hawking-core/src/metal/mod.rs:704), so the S031 §3 atlas still has no per-dispatch duration column -- what it now has is a per-LEVER one.
The atlas's BYTES and FLOPS columns remain open. The byte arithmetic here covers two levers and is derived from shapes, not instrumented.
The lake fill and mlx_boot were not quiesced by force at any point; the admitted window was waited for, not created.
next: the two levers FINDING_7 leaves open -- capability 30 -> 36 at fixed EBPW, or EBPW 3.14 -> 2.62 at fixed capability -- because the graph has 1.65x left and the §19 target needs 1.20x of CEILING the graph cannot supply. structured_output at 5/15 is 10 of the 13 failing cases, so capability is where the reachable lever is, and S031 §20 already names it as a first-class HCLI organ.

FINDING_7_THE_BANDWIDTH_WALL_TURNS_S031_.and_it_does_NOT_retire_the_EBPW_axis_it_: S031 §0 says stop treating lower EBPW as the PRIMARY route to throughput, and this block's own headline agrees for the graph. But the wall itself is made of bytes: raw TPS ceiling is 187.40/EBPW exactly. Below ~2.6 EBPW at 30/43 the target opens. The correct reading is that EBPW buys CEILING while the graph buys APPROACH, they are not substitutes, and the resident is at 60.7% of approach with a ceiling 20% too low.
claim_boundary: KV-CACHE READS ARE NOT COUNTED and they grow with context, so the true byte count per token is HIGHER and every ceiling here is OPTIMISTIC. That is the safe direction for an 'unreachable' claim and the wrong direction for a 'reachable' one -- the 59.7 raw ceiling in particular should be read as an upper bound nobody will touch.

589.73 GB/s is a MEASURED F32 TRIAD (two reads and a write). A decode matvec is read-dominated and read-only bandwidth on this SoC is not measured here, so the wall could sit somewhat higher. Named as an assumption, not folded into the numbers.
the curve holds the EMBEDDING SHARE fixed at 6.40% as EBPW varies, which is right for a body recompressed uniformly and wrong for one that recompresses the head differently.
activation and KV traffic, the argmax, and the sampler are all excluded; they are small next to 9.879 GB but they are not zero.
one machine, one artifact, INSTANCE. 187.40 is a constant of THIS SoC and THIS parameter count and transfers to neither another machine nor another model.
